game.title: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
game.developer: Gearbox Software (Enhanced edition by Blind Squirrel Games)
game.renderer_notes: A d3d9.dll proxy saw only D3DPERF_BeginEvent/EndEvent while d3d11.dll and dxgi.dll are loaded in-process, so it draws with D3D11 [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. The exe's static d3d9 import is misleading.
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on RTX (home PC, 3440x1440 desktop): started BorderlandsGOTY.exe directly, windowed 1280x720 from the command line, closed with WM_CLOSE.

states.name: 2k_launcher_error
states.detect: The Steam launch opens Launcher.exe (a WPF 2K launcher), which showed 'Initialization error. Please ensure the game files have not been corrupted or moved.' with Ok, on a clean install.

steps: with Steam running, start <game>\Binaries\Win64\BorderlandsGOTY.exe directly (steam_appid.txt is beside it) with the arguments -windowed ResX=1280 ResY=720
routes.notes: 1296x759 window [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. This skips the 2K launcher, which errored.

steps: PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game's top-level window

config_files: Documents\My Games\Borderlands Game of the Year\WillowGame\Config\WillowEngine.ini [SystemSettings] WindowMode: 0 fullscreen, 1 windowed, 2 borderless, per the comment in the game's DefaultEngine.ini [inferred-static 2026-09-17]. WindowMode=1 gives a window [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1], but ResX/ResY there do not hold (see disproved).
entry_points.proxy_dll: d3d9.dll is the wrong DLL (see game.renderer_notes); use dxgi.dll or d3d11.dll.

hazards.hazard: The Steam launch goes through the 2K Launcher, which errored
hazards.notes: 'Initialization error' on a clean install. Start BorderlandsGOTY.exe directly.

hazards.hazard: A Windows Firewall prompt on the first run steals focus
hazards.notes: A Windows Defender Firewall 'allow access' dialog appeared on the first launch on this machine and took focus from the game. The main session pressed Cancel; answering it is left to the user. Losing focus can minimise a fullscreen game.

disproved.claim: WillowEngine.ini ResX=1280 ResY=720 sets the window size
disproved.result: No - rewritten to 1920x1080 on launch. Use the command line.

disproved.claim: The game renders through d3d9 because it imports d3d9.dll
disproved.result: No - the d3d9 proxy saw only D3DPERF_BeginEvent/EndEvent; d3d11 and dxgi are loaded.
